config.prompt:
This email has no order number. Find the customer's order and type its number (for example AB-123456), or type none if they have no order.

{{ state.message }}

Sort this support email into one category. Answer with one lowercase word only: urgent, billing, delivery or other.

urgent: something is broken right now, money was taken by mistake, or the customer says they will leave
billing: invoices, refunds, payment methods or plan changes that can wait a day
delivery: where an order is, or a late, damaged or missing item
other: anything else

{{ state.message }}

files.events/{{workflow_key}}_email.py:
"""Start the support inbox workflow for every email the support address receives.

Your mail system sends the event to POST /v1/projects/<project>/events, or try it with Send a test event on the
Events page:

    {"type": "support.email.received",
     "data": {"message_id": "<abc123@mail.example.com>", "subject": "Charged twice", "body": "Hi, ..."}}
"""

from agentcanvas.sdk import on


# dedup_key: when the mail system delivers the same email twice, the workflow starts once
@on("support.email.received", dedup_key="event.data.message_id")
def start_support_inbox(event, act):
    """A new support email: check it, tidy it and draft a reply."""
    act.start_workflow(
        "{{workflow_id}}",
        input={"subject": event.data.get("subject", ""), "email": event.data.get("body", "")},
    )
files.scripts/support_inbox_clean.py:
"""Tidy a support email for the steps after it: drop the quoted earlier messages and the signature, find the
order number, and say whether a person needs to add it before a reply is drafted."""

import re

from agentcanvas.sdk import emit

# Order numbers look like AB-123456. Change the pattern to your shop's format.
ORDER_NUMBER = re.compile(r"\b[A-Z]{2}-\d{6}\b")
EARLIER_MESSAGE = re.compile(r"^(On .+ wrote:|-+ ?Original Message ?-+|From: .+)$", re.IGNORECASE)


def run(state: dict) -> dict:
    """Tidy the email, find its order number and say whether a person must add one."""
    subject = " ".join(str(state.get("subject") or "").split())
    lines = []
    for line in str(state.get("email") or "").splitlines():
        text = line.strip()
        if text == "--" or EARLIER_MESSAGE.match(text):
            break  # the signature, or the earlier messages of the thread
        if not text.startswith(">"):  # a quoted line
            lines.append(text)
    body = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", "\n".join(lines)).strip()
    found = ORDER_NUMBER.search(f"{subject}\n{body}")
    order_number = found.group(0) if found else ""
    try:  # other workflows can react to it with @on("support.email.tidied")
        emit("support.email.tidied", {"order_number": order_number, "needs_details": not order_number})
    except RuntimeError:
        pass  # outside a run on the server (a sandbox, a plain test) there is nowhere to send it
    return {
        "message": f"Subject: {subject}\n\n{body}" if subject else body,
        "order_number": order_number,
        "needs_details": not order_number,
    }
